title: Finite presentation is transitive for modules
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is a finitely presented $A$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], and let $M$ be a finitely presented $B$-module. Then $M$, regarded as an $A$-module through $A\to B$, is a finitely presented $A$-module.
